absorption-variable-costing-inventory-pr.shows: Make more than you sell and absorption costing parks fixed overhead in inventory with every unsold unit, so it reports more profit than variable costing
absorption-variable-costing-inventory-pr.subject: finance
absorption-variable-costing-inventory-pr.title: Absorption vs variable costing: profit and inventory

accretion-dilution.shows: Acquirer EPS before and after a deal as the stock/cash mix, the price paid and synergies change
accretion-dilution.subject: finance
accretion-dilution.title: Accretion / dilution: acquirer EPS after a deal

accrual-vs-cash-accounting.shows: Move the month the work is done and how long the customer takes to pay: cash basis follows the money, accrual follows the work, and the gap is a receivable, deferred revenue or a prepaid expense
accrual-vs-cash-accounting.subject: finance
accrual-vs-cash-accounting.title: Accrual vs cash accounting

accuracy-vs-precision-targets.shows: Move the mean and widen the spread: accuracy is how far the average lands from the bullseye, precision is how tightly the shots group
accuracy-vs-precision-targets.subject: stats
accuracy-vs-precision-targets.title: Accuracy vs precision

angular-frequency-relation.shows: Slide f and t: a point turning f times a second sweeps 2π rad per turn, so ω = 2πf rad/s, and one turn takes T = 1/f
angular-frequency-relation.subject: physics
angular-frequency-relation.title: Angular frequency and period

anova-decomposition.shows: Drag any point: each value's gap from the grand mean splits into a between-group part and a within-group part, and F weighs one against the other
anova-decomposition.subject: stats
anova-decomposition.title: ANOVA: between vs within

anova-interaction-plot.shows: Pick a pattern: parallel lines mean no interaction, spreading lines a non-crossover one, crossing lines a crossover one; the interaction is the difference between the two simple effects
anova-interaction-plot.subject: stats
anova-interaction-plot.title: Two-way ANOVA interaction plot

antibody-heavy-light-chain-fab-fc-struct.shows: Color the IgG by chain, by variable and constant domain, or by Fab and Fc, then digest it with papain or pepsin to see which pieces come apart
antibody-heavy-light-chain-fab-fc-struct.subject: biology
antibody-heavy-light-chain-fab-fc-struct.title: Antibody chains, Fab and Fc

antibody-specificity-and-antigen-neutral.shows: Pick an antibody and add more of it: only one whose binding site fits the spike's epitope binds, and a virus is neutralized only when every one of its spikes is covered
antibody-specificity-and-antigen-neutral.subject: biology
antibody-specificity-and-antigen-neutral.title: Antibody specificity and neutralization

antibody-structure.shows: Switch the class: every antibody is built from Y units of two heavy and two light chains, and the classes differ in how many units, which heavy chain, and the hinge
antibody-structure.subject: biology
antibody-structure.title: Antibody structure and classes

arithmetic-mean.shows: Change the three values: the mean is the equal share of their total, and the balance point where the deviations cancel
arithmetic-mean.subject: stats
arithmetic-mean.title: The arithmetic mean

autocorrelation.shows: Pick a pattern and a lag: r_k correlates the series with itself k steps later, and the correlogram shows it for every lag
autocorrelation.subject: stats
autocorrelation.title: Autocorrelation and the correlogram

average-speed-distance-time.shows: Set two legs of a trip: the average speed is the slope of the start-to-finish chord, total distance over total time, not the mean of the two speeds
average-speed-distance-time.subject: physics
average-speed-distance-time.title: Average speed: distance over time

b-cell-plasma-cell-antibody-secretion.shows: Step from antigen binding through T-cell help and clonal expansion to plasma cells; set divisions, plasma share and rate to see the antibody output
b-cell-plasma-cell-antibody-secretion.subject: biology
b-cell-plasma-cell-antibody-secretion.title: B cell to plasma cell: antibody secretion

bacterial-transformation-antibiotic-sele.shows: Step through ice, heat shock, recovery and plating; change the DNA, the efficiency or the plate to see which cells grow and how many colonies you get
bacterial-transformation-antibiotic-sele.subject: biology
bacterial-transformation-antibiotic-sele.title: Transformation and antibiotic selection

bacterial-transformation-free-dna-uptake.shows: Step a cell through taking up a free plasmid, then set the colonies, the DNA and the share plated to get the transformation efficiency
bacterial-transformation-free-dna-uptake.subject: biology
bacterial-transformation-free-dna-uptake.title: Bacterial transformation: taking up free DNA

biotechnology.shows: Pick the enzyme that cuts the plasmid and the one that cuts the gene, then step through pairing, ligation, transformation and expression
biotechnology.subject: biology
biotechnology.title: Recombinant DNA: putting a gene into a plasmid

blue-white-screening.shows: Set how many plasmids carry the insert and what is in the plate: white colonies have the insert, blue ones are empty vector
blue-white-screening.subject: biology
blue-white-screening.title: Blue-white screening

cell-type-specific-transcription-factors.shows: Switch the cell type or add one activator: a gene is transcribed only when the cell has an activator for every control element in its enhancer
cell-type-specific-transcription-factors.subject: biology
cell-type-specific-transcription-factors.title: Cell-type-specific transcription factors

change-of-basis.shows: The same vector in B-coordinates and in standard coordinates: P, whose columns are b1 and b2, turns one into the other
change-of-basis.subject: linear-algebra
change-of-basis.title: Change of basis

coding-strand-mrna-sequence-relationship.shows: Slide along the first codons of beta-globin: the mRNA matches the coding strand letter for letter, with U in place of T
coding-strand-mrna-sequence-relationship.subject: biology
coding-strand-mrna-sequence-relationship.title: Coding strand and mRNA: same sequence, U for T

coding-template-rna-strand-comparison.shows: Slide RNA polymerase along a short gene and compare any two strands: coding and RNA match (U for T), the template pairs with both
coding-template-rna-strand-comparison.subject: biology
coding-template-rna-strand-comparison.title: Coding, template and RNA strands compared

codon-anticodon-pairing.shows: Build a codon base by base: the tRNA's anticodon pairs with it antiparallel and brings the matching amino acid; turn on wobble to see one tRNA read several codons
codon-anticodon-pairing.subject: biology
codon-anticodon-pairing.title: Codon and anticodon pairing

codon-chart.shows: Pick the three bases of an mRNA codon: first base picks the row, second the column, third the line; the codon and every synonym for its amino acid light up
codon-chart.subject: biology
codon-chart.title: The genetic code: reading a codon

column-space.shows: Ax is a combination of the columns of A, so every output lands in Col A: a line, a plane or all of R3 depending on the rank
column-space.subject: linear-algebra
column-space.title: Column space

compound-interest.shows: Slide the rate and the number of periods: the balance grows by 1 + r each period, and the amber interest on interest is what makes the curve bend upward
compound-interest.subject: finance
compound-interest.title: Compound interest

coordinates-in-a-basis.shows: The same vector written in two bases; drag the basis and its coordinates change
coordinates-in-a-basis.subject: linear-algebra
coordinates-in-a-basis.title: Coordinates in a basis

crispr-cas9.shows: Step through guide loading, PAM search, the double-strand cut and the repair; switch the goal to see NHEJ knock a gene out or HDR copy in a precise edit
crispr-cas9.subject: biology
crispr-cas9.title: CRISPR-Cas9 gene editing

crispr-cas9-target-recognition.shows: Toggle the PAM and move a guide mismatch along the target: Cas9 needs NGG, pairs the seed next to it first, and only a full R-loop leads to a cut
crispr-cas9-target-recognition.subject: biology
crispr-cas9-target-recognition.title: How Cas9 recognizes its target

crispr-dna-repair-outcomes.shows: Choose the repair pathway and the NHEJ indel size: indels that aren't a multiple of 3 shift the reading frame into an early stop codon, while HDR writes in the donor's exact change
crispr-dna-repair-outcomes.subject: biology
crispr-dna-repair-outcomes.title: Repairing a Cas9 cut: NHEJ or HDR

crispr-guide-directed-dna-cleavage.shows: Slide the guide along the DNA: Cas9 cuts only where an NGG PAM follows the matched 20 bases, always 3 bp from the PAM, with RuvC and HNH each cutting one strand
crispr-guide-directed-dna-cleavage.subject: biology
crispr-guide-directed-dna-cleavage.title: Guide-directed cutting by Cas9

currency-appreciation.shows: Pick an event and its size: demand for dollars rises or supply falls, the market clears at more euros per dollar, and the dollar appreciates
currency-appreciation.subject: finance
currency-appreciation.title: Why a currency appreciates

dcf.shows: Free cash flows grow for five years, each is discounted back to today, and they add up with the discounted terminal value into enterprise value
dcf.subject: finance
dcf.title: DCF: from free cash flows to enterprise value

dna-gel-fragment-migration.shows: Slide the run time and the fragment size: DNA runs toward +, small fragments run farther, and distance is a straight line against log size (log base 10)
dna-gel-fragment-migration.subject: biology
dna-gel-fragment-migration.title: Gel electrophoresis: how far a fragment runs

dna-replication.shows: Step through a replication fork: helicase opens it, primase lays RNA primers, polymerase builds the leading strand continuously and the lagging strand in Okazaki fragments, then pol I and ligase finish the job
dna-replication.subject: biology
dna-replication.title: DNA replication at the fork

dna-replication-antiparallel-template-po.shows: Flip the template's orientation and add nucleotides: the new strand always grows 5′→3′ off a 3′-OH, so it runs toward the fork on one template (leading) and away on the other (lagging)
dna-replication-antiparallel-template-po.subject: biology
dna-replication-antiparallel-template-po.title: Antiparallel strands: which way a new strand grows

dot-product-angle.shows: Drag u and v: u·v is |u| times the signed length of v's shadow on u, so it is positive for an acute angle, zero at 90° and negative past it
dot-product-angle.subject: linear-algebra
dot-product-angle.title: Dot product and the angle between vectors

double-entry-transaction-effects.shows: Pick a transaction: one account is debited and one credited, and Assets = Liabilities + Equity stays balanced after every entry
double-entry-transaction-effects.subject: finance
double-entry-transaction-effects.title: Double entry: one transaction, two accounts

eigendirections.shows: Change A and drag the probe x around the circle: Ax swings off x's line except along an eigendirection, where A only stretches by λ
eigendirections.subject: linear-algebra
eigendirections.title: Eigenvectors: the directions a matrix keeps

elementary-row-operations.shows: Step through swap, replace and scale: each row is a line, each operation moves a line, and the crossing point (the solution) never moves
elementary-row-operations.subject: linear-algebra
elementary-row-operations.title: Elementary row operations

elisa.shows: Step through the four layers of a sandwich ELISA; slide the antigen concentration: more antigen captured means more enzyme, more color, and a higher reading on the standard curve
elisa.subject: biology
elisa.title: Sandwich ELISA

ev-equity-bridge.shows: Equity value plus debt, preferred and minority interest, minus cash, equals enterprise value; the balance-sheet view shows why cash comes off
ev-equity-bridge.subject: finance
ev-equity-bridge.title: Equity value to enterprise value

fifo-lifo-cost-flow.shows: Slide units sold and flip the cost trend: FIFO expenses the oldest batches first and LIFO the newest, so when costs move the two report different COGS and inventory
fifo-lifo-cost-flow.subject: finance
fifo-lifo-cost-flow.title: FIFO vs LIFO cost flow

foreign-exchange-market.shows: Shift the demand for and supply of euros: the exchange rate settles where they cross, and the euro appreciates when demand rises or supply falls
foreign-exchange-market.subject: finance
foreign-exchange-market.title: The foreign exchange market

futures-hedge-locked-revenue.shows: Drag the harvest price: spot sales and the short futures move in opposite directions, so a full hedge always adds up to q times the futures price
futures-hedge-locked-revenue.subject: finance
futures-hedge-locked-revenue.title: Futures hedge: locking in revenue

kernel-image.shows: Drag x in the input plane: T(x) moves in the output plane; the kernel line is crushed to 0 and the image is the set T can reach
kernel-image.subject: linear-algebra
kernel-image.title: Kernel and image of a linear map

lbo-returns.shows: Entry multiple, leverage, EBITDA growth and exit multiple turn into the equity's MOIC and IRR, split into growth, multiple and debt paydown
lbo-returns.subject: finance
lbo-returns.title: LBO returns: IRR and MOIC

linear-combination.shows: Slide a and b, or drag w: w = a u + b v is a walk of a steps along u then b steps along v; negative coefficients walk backwards
linear-combination.subject: linear-algebra
linear-combination.title: Linear combination of two vectors

linear-independence-discriminant.shows: Drag u and v: the parallelogram they span has area |det(u, v)|; when it collapses to zero the two vectors are dependent and span only a line
linear-independence-discriminant.subject: linear-algebra
linear-independence-discriminant.title: Span and linear independence

matrix-inverse-2d.shows: Change A and x: A moves the grid and x into the output plane, and A⁻¹ = (1/det A)·[d −b; −c a] brings Ax back to x, unless det A = 0
matrix-inverse-2d.subject: linear-algebra
matrix-inverse-2d.title: The inverse of a 2×2 matrix

matrix-multiplication-row-column-rule.shows: Step through AB: each entry c_ij is row i of A dotted with column j of B, so the inner sizes must match
matrix-multiplication-row-column-rule.subject: linear-algebra
matrix-multiplication-row-column-rule.title: Matrix multiplication: the row-column rule

matrix-of-a-map.shows: The columns of the matrix are the images of the basis vectors
matrix-of-a-map.subject: linear-algebra
matrix-of-a-map.title: The matrix of a linear map

matrix-transformation-2d.shows: Change the entries of A: the columns are where e1 and e2 land, the grid moves with them, and det A scales areas
matrix-transformation-2d.subject: linear-algebra
matrix-transformation-2d.title: A matrix as a map of the plane

mrna-translation.shows: Step the ribosome along the mRNA: tRNAs pair with each codon, the chain moves onto the newest amino acid, and a stop codon ends it; try a one-base mutation
mrna-translation.subject: biology
mrna-translation.title: Translation: mRNA to protein

null-space.shows: Change the rank of a 3×3 matrix: the solutions of Ax = 0 shrink from a plane to a line to just 0 while the columns grow from a line to a plane to all of space
null-space.subject: linear-algebra
null-space.title: Null space and column space

pcr-cycle.shows: Step through denature, anneal and extend on one template; slide the cycle count to see the copies double every cycle
pcr-cycle.subject: biology
pcr-cycle.title: PCR: one cycle, then doubling

pcr-exponential-dna-amplification.shows: Slide the cycles, the efficiency and the starting copies: the copies grow as N0(1 + E)^n, a hockey stick on a linear axis and a straight line on a log axis
pcr-exponential-dna-amplification.subject: biology
pcr-exponential-dna-amplification.title: PCR: exponential amplification

pcr-primer-directed-extension.shows: Slide the extension: polymerase adds bases only to each primer's 3′ end, pairing with the template; give the forward primer a 3′ mismatch or a 5′ tail to see why only the 3′ end must pair
pcr-primer-directed-extension.subject: biology
pcr-primer-directed-extension.title: PCR: primers direct the extension

pcr-temperature-cycle-overview.shows: Step through a full PCR run on the thermocycler; slide the annealing temperature against the primers' Tm, the product length (which sets the extension time) and the cycles
pcr-temperature-cycle-overview.subject: biology
pcr-temperature-cycle-overview.title: PCR: the temperature program

plasmid-sticky-end-ligation.shows: Pick the enzyme that cut the insert and step through cutting, pairing and sealing: only complementary overhangs pair, and only ligase makes the join permanent
plasmid-sticky-end-ligation.subject: biology
plasmid-sticky-end-ligation.title: Sticky ends and ligation

power-iteration.shows: Step k up and drag the start x₀: multiplying by A and rescaling pulls x onto the dominant eigendirection, faster when |λ₂/λ₁| is small
power-iteration.subject: linear-algebra
power-iteration.title: Power iteration: finding the dominant eigenvector

present-value-discounting.shows: Slide the rate and the years: the future amount shrinks by 1 + r for every year it is pulled back to today
present-value-discounting.subject: finance
present-value-discounting.title: Present value: discounting a future cash flow

prokaryotic-operon-architecture.shows: Switch between the lac and trp operons and add or remove the small molecule: one promoter and operator switch several genes on together as one mRNA
prokaryotic-operon-architecture.subject: biology
prokaryotic-operon-architecture.title: Operon architecture: lac and trp

promoter-rna-polymerase-initiation.shows: Set how well the -35 and -10 boxes match consensus and the spacer between them, then step through binding, DNA opening, the first RNA and σ letting go
promoter-rna-polymerase-initiation.subject: biology
promoter-rna-polymerase-initiation.title: Promoter: how RNA polymerase starts

qpcr-fold-change.shows: Slide the four Ct values: normalize the target to the reference gene, compare treated with control, and every cycle of difference is a factor of two
qpcr-fold-change.subject: biology
qpcr-fold-change.title: qPCR: ΔΔCt to fold change

rank-nullity.shows: Rank plus nullity equals the number of columns, shown as dimensions that trade off
rank-nullity.subject: linear-algebra
rank-nullity.title: Rank plus nullity

rates-and-bonds.shows: Move the yield: every bond's price slides the other way along a curve, a long bond moves far more than a short one, and the curve bends above the duration line
rates-and-bonds.subject: finance
rates-and-bonds.title: Rates up, bond prices down

recombinant-dna-plasmid-workflow.shows: Step through digest, ligation, transformation, selection and screening; compare cutting with one enzyme against two
recombinant-dna-plasmid-workflow.subject: biology
recombinant-dna-plasmid-workflow.title: Cloning a gene into a plasmid

row-reduction-stepper.shows: Gaussian elimination one row operation at a time to reduced row echelon form
row-reduction-stepper.subject: linear-algebra
row-reduction-stepper.title: Row reduction, one step at a time

sanger-sequencing.shows: Step from one copy stopped by a ddNTP, to fragments ending at every base, to the capillary read; slide the ddNTP fraction to see how far the read reaches
sanger-sequencing.subject: biology
sanger-sequencing.title: Sanger sequencing

shifted-inverse-iteration.shows: Pick a mode and slide the shift σ: each step multiplies x's part along eigenvector vᵢ by μᵢ, so the eigenvector with the biggest |μᵢ| takes over; (A − σI)⁻¹ picks the eigenvalue nearest σ
shifted-inverse-iteration.subject: linear-algebra
shifted-inverse-iteration.title: Shifted and inverse iteration

singular-value-decomposition.shows: Slide the rank k: the SVD writes A as a sum of rank-one layers σᵢuᵢvᵢᵀ, largest first, and keeping the first k gives the best rank-k copy of A
singular-value-decomposition.subject: linear-algebra
singular-value-decomposition.title: SVD: rebuilding a matrix from its biggest pieces

span-membership.shows: Is b in the span of v1, v2: solve for the weights or show the system has none
span-membership.subject: linear-algebra
span-membership.title: Is b in the span?

standard-error-vs-sd.shows: Slide n: single readings keep their spread (SD), but the mean of n readings tightens as SE = σ/√n
standard-error-vs-sd.subject: stats
standard-error-vs-sd.title: Standard deviation vs standard error

straight-line-depreciation.shows: Slide cost, salvage, life and age: book value drops by the same (C − S)/L every year until it reaches salvage, and accumulated depreciation fills the gap
straight-line-depreciation.subject: finance
straight-line-depreciation.title: Straight-line depreciation

subspace-test.shows: Is a subset of R2 a subspace: check it holds the zero vector and is closed under addition and scalar multiplication
subspace-test.subject: linear-algebra
subspace-test.title: Subspace test

system-linear-equations-cases.shows: Change the two equations: crossing lines give one solution, parallel lines none, the same line infinitely many; det A and the ranks say which
system-linear-equations-cases.subject: linear-algebra
system-linear-equations-cases.title: Two equations: one, none or infinitely many solutions

system-of-equations.shows: Step through elimination: subtracting a multiple of one equation kills x, which turns one line horizontal through the crossing, then back-substitution finds x
system-of-equations.subject: linear-algebra
system-of-equations.title: Solving two equations by elimination

three-statement-flow.shows: Pick a transaction (depreciation, capex, a debt raise, interest, a dividend) and step it through the income statement, the cash flow statement and the balance sheet
three-statement-flow.subject: finance
three-statement-flow.title: One transaction through the three statements

trp-operon-corepressor-switch.shows: Raise the tryptophan: Trp loads the repressor, the loaded repressor sits on the operator and RNA polymerase is shut out; trpR⁻ and Oc mutants stay on
trp-operon-corepressor-switch.subject: biology
trp-operon-corepressor-switch.title: trp operon: tryptophan as corepressor

vector-dot-product.shows: Drag a and b: a·b is ax·bx + ay·by and also |a||b|cos θ, so it is positive for an acute angle, zero at 90° and negative past it
vector-dot-product.subject: linear-algebra
vector-dot-product.title: The dot product and the angle

vector-projection.shows: Drag a and b: the projection is the multiple of b closest to a, (a·b / |b|²) b, and the leftover a − proj meets b's line at a right angle
vector-projection.subject: linear-algebra
vector-projection.title: Projecting one vector onto another

wacc.shows: Slide the mix, beta and the debt terms: each source's cost is weighted by its share of capital, and WACC is the average height of the two blocks
wacc.subject: finance
wacc.title: WACC: the blended cost of capital

western-blot.shows: Step through gel, transfer, primary and secondary antibody; slide the target's size to move its band and the treated level to change its brightness
western-blot.subject: biology
western-blot.title: Western blot
